title: Goodwill Credits on Credit Builder Accounts Late Fees
content:
## The goodwill credit

A goodwill credit on a late fee is a courtesy waiver granted on the borrower's request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the account, and it credits the part of the late fee the Credit Builder Accounts goodwill policy sets out rather than the whole fee; a returned-payment fee relief once its payment has been made good and the early-closure late-fee and returned-fee reliefs each follow their own rule, and any other courtesy waiver is still granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the account.

While the account has a pending early-closure request, the early-closure late-fee relief takes priority over a goodwill credit on the same late fee, and the goodwill credit is not granted.

The goodwill credit is figured only once the account's most recent returned payment, when its return code carries a fee, shows its returned-payment fee on the account, unless that fee comes to 0.00.

The goodwill credit is figured only after the made-good relief owed on the account, if any, has been granted.

A goodwill credit for a borrower whose most recent AutoPay debit (the latest payment made through the AutoPay channel; when two were posted on the same day, the one booked first counts as the latest) was returned, the return line pointing at it being dated in the 3 whole calendar months before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 3 months earlier falls outside them), is not granted until the account is enrolled in AutoPay.

| Credit Builder account facts when the borrower asks | Goodwill credit |
|---|---|
| a late fee the borrower still owes, courtesy waivers within the plan's number, no pending early-closure request | may be granted, for the part of the fee the goodwill policy sets |
| an early-closure request pending confirmation | not granted |
| the most recent AutoPay debit returned within the 3 months, account not enrolled in AutoPay | not granted |
| the most recent AutoPay debit returned within the 3 months, account enrolled in AutoPay | the AutoPay condition is met |

## Booking the credit: `credit_goodwill_late_fee_43fbbd15`

**What it does.** The tool grants a goodwill credit on one late fee of a Credit Builder account at the borrower's request. It books a fee waiver entry with the courtesy basis, dated today and linked to the late fee it credits, and lowers the account's unpaid fees by the credit. The borrower sees the credit and the lower unpaid-fee balance on the account.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_goodwill_late_fee_43fbbd15` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `builder_account_id` | reference number of the Credit Builder account, as returned by the Credit Builder account lookup |
| `related_txn_id` | reference number of the late fee entry being credited, as listed among the account's entries by the Credit Builder entry lookup |
| `credit_amount` | the credit in USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Goodwill credit <entry reference> of <amount> USD booked on <account reference> against late fee <entry reference>; unpaid fees now <amount> USD.", where amounts are in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving this text means the credit is on the account.
